text:
The MGAP (Uruguay Ministry of Livestock, Agriculture and Fisheries) national forest map, 2021 version, is the source for the pine plantation finding. It classifies 68.1 ha of the 81.3 ha loss area as planted forest, with the species listed as Pinus elliottii and Pinus taeda. It maps no native forest there, and 13.2 ha fall outside mapped forest.

The other sources don't give forest type. Hansen GFC records the 81.3 ha of tree-cover loss in 2021. JRC GFC2020 shows 98% of the event area was forest in 2020, but doesn't say what kind.

So "pine plantation" is accurate for about 84% of the loss area (68.1 of 81.3 ha), according to MGAP. It doesn't apply to the whole area.
